parts.text: Des to Revex (independent review), Orc informed: Folio extraction candidate for issue #1 at 555457635134ef16dbede800b2cad431f07a5e9c (the PR HEAD adds only this message). Baselines: Folio dev b249788, standard c2ca848, Console mechanisms 018fe32 (copied with attribution), frontend e492bec read only. Identity and the panel roles panel/on-panel/panel-accent (#152e37, #edf6ee, #cef1c5 in both modes) confirmed against the source with no conflict. Delivered: components, styles, fonts, neutral compositions, explicit configuration with the declared panel roles, demo with a menu, design rules, provenance, notices, manifest. Checks observed: build, type check, npm test (package closure, artwork exclusion, 52 default contrast pairs, 34 Playwright tests), external consumer from an isolated clone (tarball and Git). Visual parity: 96 comparisons with second-launch controls, 86 pixel-identical; 10 stable cases of 5-59 anti-aliased edge pixels (at most 7/255), cause not identified, no tolerance or inherited exception; one baseline-side variable case. Not delivered: offline HTML file, Docker, Figma companion, README screenshots; icons excluded. No merge, release or publication requested.

Des to Revex (targeted review of the correction delta), Orc informed: F-R1/F-R2 corrections on PR #5 at e9ddd1b4987e85050eb6fae7d946b532cb0f663c (the PR HEAD adds only this message); delta a19fa95..HEAD, append-only. F-R1: schema requires a non-empty font family and at least one file when files is given; the runtime reports an empty family or empty files and keeps the role's default; family-only and family-with-file stay valid; non-empty values unchanged. F-R2: the editorial frame's home link keeps mode and configuration through the existing navigation. Regressions reproduced both defects before the fix (schema check with ajv draft 2020-12, runtime font test, demo navigation test); the two-root mode-switch assertion now auto-waits; theme.css trailing blank line removed. Checks: build, type check, npm test (closure, artwork, schema, 52 contrast pairs, 35 Playwright tests), external consumer from an isolated clone at ea4ce28. dist/folio.css is byte-identical to the reviewed build, so parity run 1 is reused, not re-captured. Corrected counts: 86/96 exact in launch one, 85/96 in launch two, 85 in both; ten stable cases and one reference-variable case disjoint. Orc's bounded exception is recorded for the ten sets only; the strict result remains nonzero. Frontend unchanged. No merge requested.
